display.purpose: Page-level identity headings. One per view maximum.

body.purpose: AI-generated summaries and prose content. Max 65–75ch.

label.purpose: Badges, status chips, quiz meta labels. Uppercase, tracked.

shadows.name: ambient-drop
shadows.purpose: Applied to all .glass-card surfaces at rest. Structural depth.

shadows.name: plasma-glow
shadows.purpose: Hover state on interactive glass cards only. Never at rest.

shadows.name: quiz-vault
shadows.purpose: Quiz overlay vessel exclusively. Maximum depth for focus-mode interfaces.

shadows.name: quiz-btn-white
shadows.purpose: Quiz confirm button (white fill variant). Subtle lift.

shadows.name: quiz-btn-blue
shadows.purpose: Quiz primary action button (Cerulean/blue fill variant).

motion.name: ease-house
motion.purpose: Standard easing for all transitions and entrances. Fast exit, ease into rest.

motion.name: reveal-entrance
motion.purpose: Element reveal on mount. Used by .animate-reveal.

motion.name: quiz-vessel-entrance
motion.value: opacity 0 -> 1, translateY(40px) scale(0.95) -> translateY(0) scale(1), duration 0.6s, ease-house

motion.name: aurora-drift
motion.value: translate(3vw, 5vh) rotate(3deg) scale(1.1), duration 60s, ease-in-out, infinite alternate
motion.purpose: Background aurora breathing. Disable with prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Dashboard collapses to single column. Carousel masks hidden.

breakpoints.name: quiz-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Quiz vessel switches from two-column to single-column stacked layout.

narrative.overview:
Raw academic material enters; distilled intelligence exits. The dashboard is not the process, it is the output surface. The system has already done its work in the background, monitoring platforms, parsing documents, generating summaries. When the student opens IDP Core, the hard part is done. The interface exists to make that truth visible.

This means surfaces are restrained almost to the point of disappearance. Near-void backgrounds (lightness 1–4%) make every lit element intentional. Three precision accents — Plasma, Violet Current, Cerulean — operate as semantic signals: they mark interaction, categorization, and information, never decoration.

The system explicitly rejects two failure modes: the institutional LMS aesthetic (Moodle beige, Canvas blue, dense tables) and the crypto dashboard mode (neon on black with no restraint, purple gradients saturating every surface). High energy does not mean visual noise. Restraint is the difference between premium and chaotic.
keyCharacteristics: Extreme dark ground: backgrounds between Onyx Deep (#020203) and Onyx Soft (#09090b)
Three-accent discipline: each color assigned one semantic role and held to it
Precision minimal: every surface earns its opacity; rest state is near-invisible
Typographic authority: Outfit at display sizes, Inter for legible body prose
Motion communicates system state, not aesthetic intent
Gamification delivered with restraint: feedback through color shift, not fanfare

rules.name: The Precision Accent Rule
rules.body: Plasma, Violet Current, and Cerulean are semantic signals, not fills. Using any of them as a surface background, decorative border, or gradient ingredient contradicts the system. When in doubt, no accent.

rules.name: The Void Foundation Rule
rules.body: Backgrounds live between Onyx Deep (#020203) and Onyx Soft (#09090b). No lighter dark tones. Brightness is reserved for text and accent signals only.

rules.name: The Aurora Rule
rules.body: The three accents exist in the background aurora at opacity 0.03–0.08. This is their only decorative use. On any rendered surface, they are interactive or informational.

rules.name: The Display-Only Rule
rules.body: Outfit appears at 1.35rem and above. Below that, Inter handles everything.

rules.name: The Prose Max-Width Rule
rules.body: AI-generated summary text must be constrained to 65–75ch. Unconstrained prose reads as machine output; constrained prose reads as curated intelligence.

rules.name: The Glow-On-Hover Rule
rules.body: The Plasma glow shadow appears only on hover, never at rest. A glowing surface at rest means accent is doing decorative work it must not do.

rules.name: The Aurora-Or-Nothing Rule
rules.body: Backdrop-filter blur (40px) is justified only where the aurora gradient layer is visible underneath.

dos: Do use Plasma (#00d4ff) exclusively on interactive states, hover borders, input focus rings, and the single primary accent per screen.
Do set AI-generated summary prose to a max-width of 65–75ch.
Do use cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for all entrances and state transitions.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: aurora animation and quiz vessel entrance must be disabled.
Do maintain WCAG 2.1 AA contrast ratios throughout.
Do treat the quiz vessel's two-panel split as the template for all focus-mode overlays.
Do animate transform and opacity only.
donts: Don't build screens with light/white backgrounds, pastel accent buttons, or gradient-text metric cards.
Don't saturate surfaces with all three accents simultaneously as fills, borders, and backgrounds.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text with a gradient background).
Don't use border-left or border-right wider than 1px as a colored stripe on cards or callouts.
Don't apply backdrop-filter blur to surfaces that don't sit over the aurora gradient layer.
Don't animate quiz correct/wrong states with bounces, particles, or celebration sequences.
Don't use Ghost Signal (#6d6d78) for body text — it fails AA contrast on Onyx Deep backgrounds.
